work.description: Letters CCXLIII (numeral OCR CEXeHl,) commute Canon Tarquini’s legacy for Sunday confessors and catechists at S. Salome, Veroli, into a fund under the bishop for rural missions; stray marks LF52504 (native height 33 px between protocol lines) excluded; LF52545 → LF52551 across running title LF52548; LF52609 → LF52618 across own provenance LF52612 and running title LF52615; complete 31 August 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF52501–52501; the source closing at LF52652–52655 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Ma- iorem sub annulo piscatoris die trigesima prima augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
